description: This file defines a React functional component named `ViewDetailsModal` that renders a modal displaying detailed JSON data. It handles formatting labels, rendering primitive and complex values, and special handling for specific cost-related keys. The component uses various utility functions for formatting currencies and labels, and manages display styling for the data presentation.
